description: Line-of-sight guidance that converts a declared path-relative geometry into a bounded guidance command.
implementation_notes: This is a proposed roadmap item; the current UEF specification does not define its API or equations. Purpose: Line-of-sight guidance that converts a declared path-relative geometry into a bounded guidance command. Family contract work: declare navigation/body/world frames, angle and quaternion conventions, timestamp source, actuator or sensor units, and saturation/invalid-fix behavior. Define path frame, cross-track sign, look-ahead or convergence law, singularity handling, and inner-loop command units. Before coding, define typed configuration and fixed-size state, dimensions and units, initialization/reset, aliasing, coefficient/model ownership, numeric conditioning and overflow behavior, deterministic worst-case work and memory, and state/output preservation on failure. Specify a direct C API first; add a UEF-owned generated wrapper only after the same behavior is implemented and reviewed. Keep registered=false and outputs empty.
